description: Defines data structures, enums, and constants related to NR PPA (Positioning Protocol for NR) E-CID measurements, including measurement requests, results, and control messages.

classes.name: nrppa_meas_quantities_value
classes.description: Enumeration of measurement quantity types such as cell ID, angles, and signal quality metrics.

classes.name: nrppa_meas_quantities_item
classes.description: Structure representing a measurement quantity item with its type.

classes.name: nrppa_e_cid_meas_initiation_request
classes.description: Structure for initiating a measurement request, including measurement IDs, report characteristics, periodicity, and quantities.

classes.name: nrppa_result_ss_rsrp_per_ssb_item
classes.description: Represents RSRP measurement per SSB index.

classes.name: nrppa_result_ss_rsrp_item
classes.description: Contains RSRP measurement results for a cell, including per-SSB details.

classes.name: nrppa_result_ss_rsrq_per_ssb_item
classes.description: Represents RSRQ measurement per SSB index.

classes.name: nrppa_result_ss_rsrq_item
classes.description: Contains RSRQ measurement results for a cell, including per-SSB details.

classes.name: nrppa_result_csi_rsrp_per_csi_rs_item
classes.description: CSI RSRP measurement per CSI resource index.

classes.name: nrppa_result_csi_rsrp_item
classes.description: Contains CSI RSRP measurement results for a cell.

classes.name: nrppa_result_csi_rsrq_per_csi_rs_item
classes.description: CSI RSRQ measurement per CSI resource index.

classes.name: nrppa_result_csi_rsrq_item
classes.description: Contains CSI RSRQ measurement results for a cell.

classes.name: nrppa_ul_aoa
classes.description: Ultrasound Angle of Arrival data including azimuth, optional zenith, and coordinate translation.

classes.name: nrppa_nr_tadv
classes.description: Enumeration for TADV (Timing Advance) with min and max values.

classes.name: nrppa_measured_results_value
classes.description: Variant type holding different measurement result types.

classes.name: nrppa_e_cid_meas_result
classes.description: Aggregates measurement results including cell ID, TAC, optional position, and results.

classes.name: nrppa_e_cid_meas_initiation_response
classes.description: Response message for measurement initiation, including results and diagnostics.

classes.name: nrppa_e_cid_meas_initiation_failure
classes.description: Indicates failure to initiate measurement with cause and diagnostics.

classes.name: nrppa_e_cid_meas_failure_indication
classes.description: Indicates measurement failure with cause.

classes.name: nrppa_e_cid_meas_report
classes.description: Report of measurement results.

classes.name: nrppa_e_cid_meas_termination_command
classes.description: Command to terminate a measurement.
